Gimenez Carlos Antonio Gimenez proudly represents the people of Florida's 28th congressional district, encompassing all of Monroe County and the southwest portion of Miami-Dade County. First elected to Congress in 2020, he serves on the House Armed Services Committee, the Homeland Security Committee, and the House Select Committee on Strategic Competition between the US & the Chinese Communist Party. GIMENEZ JOINS SURVIVORS OF SOCIALISM ROUNDTABLE July 21 , 2026 WASHINGTON, D.C. - Today, Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez (FL-28) joined House Republican Conference Chairwoman Lisa McClain (R-Mich.) for a roundtable highlighting the dangers of socialism and reaffirming their commitment to defending freedom and American democracy. "As someone who fled communist Cuba as a child, I know firsthand where socialism leads," said Congressman Carlos Gimene z. "It destroys freedom, crushes opportunity, and empowers government at the expense of the people. We cannot allow the failed ideas that have devastated nations around the world to take root here in the United States. I will always fight to protect our democracy, defend individual liberty, and ensure America never becomes a socialist nation." GIMENEZ JOINS HOUSE LEADERSHIP TO WARN AGAINST THE RISE OF SOCIALISM July 14 , 2026 WASHINGTON, D.C. – Today, Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez (FL-28) joined House Republican leadership for a press conference highlighting the dangers of socialism and reaffirming America's commitment to freedom. An exile from communist Cuba, Congressman Gimenez shared his family's story of fleeing the Castro dictatorship and warned against embracing the same failed ideology that has oppressed and killed millions around the world. He emphasized that the fight against communism is not only a moral imperative but also a national security priority, citing the Cuban regime's deepening alliances with Communist China, Russia, and Iran. Congressman Gimenez reaffirmed his unwavering commitment to standing with the people of Cuba, Venezuela, and Nicaragua as they continue their struggle for freedom and democracy. " America gave my family something communist Cuba never could: freedom, opportunity, and hope, " said Congressman Carlos Gimenez . "I know firsthand that communism and socialism do not work. They destroy freedom, silence opposition, and empower regimes at the expense of their people. We must never take our liberty for granted or allow these failed ideologies to gain ground in the United States. " Watch Congressman Gimenez’s remarks HERE . ### Permalink: https://gimenez.house.gov/2026/7/congressman-carlos-a-gimenez-joins-house-leadership-to-warn-against-the-rise-of-socialism Media Kit Press Releases In The News Newsletters Youtube Positive People in FL28 Home Facebook Twitter Instagram Washington, D.C. 448 Cannon House Office Building Washington, DC 20515 Phone: (202) 225-2778 Miami 14221 SW 120th St. #115 Mia

GIMENEZ’S ONE-STOP PILOT PROGRAM EXTENSION ACT | Press Releases | Congressman Carlos Gimenez Facebook Icon Google Plus Icon Instagram Icon LinkedIn Icon Twitter Icon YouTube Icon Vimeo Icon Clients Icon Email icon Map Icon Print Icon Quote Icon icon_share Carousel Arrow - Left Carousel Arrow - Right Skip Navigation Resources for American Citizens in Israel Press Releases Home Media Press Releases Print U.S. HOUSE UNANIMOUSLY PASSES REP. GIMENEZ’S ONE-STOP PILOT PROGRAM EXTENSION ACT July 13 , 2026 WASHINGTON, D.C. - Today, the U.S. House of Representatives unanimously passed Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez's bipartisan H.R. 9388, the One-Stop Pilot Program Extension Act . The legislation extends and expands the federal One-Stop Pilot Program, allowing eligible international passengers and their checked baggage to connect to domestic flights without undergoing a second TSA screening, provided they have already been screened at trusted foreign airports that meet the United States' rigorous security standards. The bill maintains strict security requirements while reducing delays, easing congestion, and improving the travel experience for international passengers. Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez said, “ South Florida is one of the busiest international gateways in the United States, and we must keep passengers and airports moving efficiently while maintaining the highest security standards. I am proud that the House passed the bipartisan One-Stop Pilot Program Extension Act, a common-sense bill that will reduce delays, ease congestion at our airports, and improve the travel experience for international passengers without compromising safety. This legislation strengthens our aviation system, supports our economy, and reinforces America's leadership in secure and efficient international travel. ” Read the full bill HERE . Watch Congressman Gimenez remarks from the House Floor HERE. ### Permalink: https://gimenez.house.gov/2026/7/u-s-house-unanimously-passes-rep-gimenez-s-one-stop-pilot-program-extension-act Media Kit Press Releases In The News Newsletters Youtube Positive People in FL28 Home Facebook Twitter Instagram Washing

GIMENEZ WITHDRAWS AS CO-CHAIR OF CONGRESSIONAL FRIENDS OF SPAIN CAUCUS | Press Releases | Congressman Carlos Gimenez Facebook Icon Google Plus Icon Instagram Icon LinkedIn Icon Twitter Icon YouTube Icon Vimeo Icon Clients Icon Email icon Map Icon Print Icon Quote Icon icon_share Carousel Arrow - Left Carousel Arrow - Right Skip Navigation Resources for American Citizens in Israel Press Releases Home Media Press Releases Print CONGRESSMAN CARLOS A. GIMENEZ WITHDRAWS AS CO-CHAIR OF CONGRESSIONAL FRIENDS OF SPAIN CAUCUS July 8 , 2026 MIAMI, FL – Today, Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez (FL-28) announced that he has withdrawn as Co-Chair of the Congressional Friends of Spain Caucus following the Spanish government’s actions undermining our bilateral relationship & its increasingly hostile actions against America’s closest ally, the Jewish State of Israel. In a letter to Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, Congressman Gimenez said Spain’s recent policies against Israel and the Israel Defense Forces are incompatible with the democratic values the caucus was created to promote. “Spain has long been an important ally of the United States, but Prime Minister Sánchez’s government has chosen political posturing over moral clarity,” said Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez .  “I cannot continue serving as Co-Chair of a caucus dedicated to strengthening ties with a government that is actively undermining one of America’s closest allies. I stand firmly with Israel and with every democracy fighting terrorism.” Congressman Gimenez concluded his letter by expressing hope that Spain will one day return to a foreign policy rooted in support for democratic allies, the defense of freedom, and moral clarity. GIMENEZ JOINS VARNEY & CO. TO DISCUSS THE GROWING THREAT OF SOCIALISM June 26 , 2026 WASHINGTON, D.C. – Today, Congressman Carlos A. Gimenez joined Fox Business's Varney & Co . to discuss the growing influence of the far left within the Democratic Party. During the interview, Congressman Gimenez warned that moderate Democrats are losing ground to the party's most radical elements and argued that the movement increasingly embraces authoritarian ideas under the banner of socialism. Congressman Carlos Gimenez said, "What is happening in New York, with those supposed democratic socialists? No, they are not. They are actually fascists wrapped in socialism. There are images coming out of New York that are frightening to me... I have seen images like that before, back in the 1930s in Germany." ### Permalink: https://gimenez.house.gov/2026/6/congressman-carlos-a-gimenez-joins-varney-co-to-discuss-the-far-left-s-growing-influence-in-the-democratic-party Media Kit Press Releases In The News Newsletters Youtube Positive People in FL28 Home Facebook Twitter Instagram Washington, D.C. 448 Cannon House Office Building Washington, DC 20515 Phone: (202) 225-2778 Miami 14221 SW 120th St. #115 Miami, FL 33186 Phone: (305) 222-0160 Key West 1100 Simonton St. Room 1-213 Key West FL, 33040 Phone: (305) 292-4485
